items.label: Coherent press release: Coherent Showcases Optical Innovations to Scale AI (09-20-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Coherent named new optical-component products for CPO and external laser sources

set.signal: Among the new products and emerging technologies across its optical networking portfolio that Coherent said it would showcase at ECOC 2026: FlexConnect, a detachable fiber array unit connector for CPO applications designed to simplify assembly and maintenance, with repeatable plug-unplug performance, interchangeability and an epoxy-free optical path compatible with high-power lasers; OptiAlign, a high-precision fiber array unit for CPO applications designed to support precise pitch control and high fiber-channel counts, combining an internally developed V-groove with customized fiber dimensions; OptiFocus, a two-in-one coupling lens design for ELS intended to simplify optical assembly while providing high coupling efficiency; FiberPack, a passive fiber assembly kit for scale-up and scale-out architectures integrating fiber attach, micro-lens, tray and termination technologies; and OptiPolar Array X, a multi-channel polarization beam splitter array in a super-compact form factor based on glass material, optimized for multi-lane systems.

items.reason: Release lists these as 'new products and emerging technologies' (not all new products), only FlexConnect/OptiAlign are for CPO and OptiFocus for 'ELS'; FiberPack/OptiPolar are not CPO/ELS parts, and 'external laser sources' is an expansion the release never writes.
